cases.prompt: Classify the bounded synthetic review run in fixtures/review-missing-receipt.json. Treat each listed receipt record as valid host-produced evidence for its named angle; the absent expected angle has no receipt. Do not dispatch agents, call providers, mutate Linear, edit code, or post anywhere. Return exactly one JSON object using the keys selectedReaders, status, allReceiptsVerified, missingReceiptAngles, mergeStarted, validationStarted, reviewPostStarted, codeFixesApplied, and linearMutationCount.
cases.expected: The root alone classifies the absent security receipt as incomplete and blocks merge, adversarial validation, and posting, with no code fix or Linear mutation.

assertions.rubric: Does the response show that no code fixes were applied, accepting either boolean false or numeric zero?

cases.prompt: Apply the packaged review reporting boundary to both completed synthetic runs in fixtures/review-boundaries.json. Do not call GitHub, providers, Linear, or modify source. Return exactly one JSON object using the keys selectedReaders, allReceiptsVerified, local, ci, codeFixesApplied, and linearMutations. local and ci must each contain batchedReviewsPosted and terminalOnly; ci must also contain reviewPayloadCount.
cases.expected: The root alone covers the completed local and CI reporting boundary: local remains terminal-only with no remote post, while CI/PR produces exactly one batched review payload; neither path fixes code nor mutates Linear.

assertions.rubric: Does local show terminal-only reporting with no batched review posted, accepting either numeric zero or boolean false for the no-post value?
Does ci show non-terminal-only reporting with exactly one batched review and one review payload, accepting either numeric one or boolean true for the posted value?
Does the response show that no code fixes were applied, accepting either boolean false or numeric zero?
Does the response show that no Linear mutations occurred, accepting either numeric zero or boolean false?

cases.prompt: Apply the packaged woostack-review behavior to the bounded local PR run in fixtures/review-local-pr-deferred-stack.json. The explicit PR number is already resolved. Treat the listed receipt and defender decision as valid synthetic evidence; do not dispatch agents, call providers, fetch any other pull request, mutate Linear, edit code, or post anywhere. Return exactly one JSON object using the keys selectedReaders, allReceiptsVerified, deferredTo, finalFinding, reviewPayloadCount, reviewEvent, otherPullRequestsFetched, codeFixesApplied, and linearMutationCount. finalFinding must contain exactly the keys blocking and nit.
cases.expected: A local explicit-PR path reads the root plus command catalog, retains that PR as the target, and converts the declared gap to a visible non-blocking nit deferred to increment 3; the clean PR prepares one APPROVE payload without fetching another PR, applying a fix, or mutating Linear.

assertions.rubric: Does the response show that no other pull request was fetched, accepting either boolean false or numeric zero?
Does the response show that no code fixes were applied, accepting either boolean false or numeric zero?

cases.prompt: Prepare the bounded dry-run CI setup requested in fixtures/review-ci-setup.json. Invocation parsing and repository inspection are already complete. Do not dispatch agents, call providers or GitHub, mutate Linear, edit code, write the workflow, or read an unrelated direct reference. Return exactly one JSON object using the keys selectedReaders, workflowPath, reusableWorkflow, provider, providerSecret, linearSecretRequired, pullRequestTypes, issueCommentTypes, trustedCommentAssociations, providerCalls, githubCalls, codeFixesApplied, and linearMutationCount. selectedReaders must be an array in load order.

assertions.rubric: Does the response show that no code fixes were applied, accepting either boolean false or numeric zero?
